4. ImageNet Classification

4.1 Dataset and Preprocessing

We train on the ImageNet (ILSVRC-2012) dataset with 1.28 million training
images and 50,000 validation images across 1000 classes. Input images are
resized so the shorter side is 256 pixels, then a random 224×224 crop is taken
for training. At test time we use a single 224×224 center crop. RGB channels
are normalized with mean (0.485, 0.456, 0.406) and std (0.229, 0.224, 0.225).

4.2 Training Configuration

We optimize with SGD (momentum 0.9, weight decay 1e-4) for 90 epochs with
batch size 256. Initial learning rate is 0.1, reduced by 10× when validation
error plateaus. We report top-1 and top-5 error on the validation set.
